thread:
Maria Gonzalez: Heads-up — saw an increase in proxy TLS negotiation fallbacks to older ciphers in eu-west this morning after the RBAC change to the cert-provisioner role. Not sure if it's a proxy config, keys, or KMS latency.
Sam Chen: Hmm. Which proxy cluster? any traffic patterns?
Maria Gonzalez: proxy-eu-1 and proxy-eu-canary. Fallbacks mostly from internal service: model-ingest. Logs show `TLSv1.2` cipher suites being negotiated even though we advertise TLS1.3 only.
Ivan Petrov: Could be clients not honoring TLS1.3 or the proxy doing a downgrade during rewrap. Did you see any KMS unwrap errors?
Maria Gonzalez: A few WARNs: `kms_unwrap_slow > 1200ms` and then `tx: downgrade_to_legacy_cipher`. Timestamped around the same RBAC change window.
Sam Chen: That aligns with a short KMS permission window when the provisoner role couldn't rewrap certs. RBAC change may have delayed access, KMS latency -> connection fallback.
Jess Liu: @Maria can you paste a sample of the proxy TLS negotiation log (redact ids)? we need an example for the oncall playbook.
Maria Gonzalez: Sure — snippet: ```
[2024-11-08T07:12:23Z] proxy-eu-1 conn=12345 client=10.32.5.11:43218 server=10.48.2.9:4430 tls_handshake: client_negotiated=TLS1.2; server_offered=TLS1.3; cipher=TLS_ECDHE_RSA_WITH_AES_128_GCM_SHA256; reason=KMS_UNWRAP_SLOW
[2024-11-08T07:12:23Z] cert-provisioner: rewrap request id=wrp-xxxxx status=delayed permission=403
```
Ivan Petrov: That 403 + slow unwrap strongly suggests RBAC scoping on the new role. If the cert-provisioner lacked kms:Decrypt for the key version we rewrap to, it might trigger a fallback flow that forces legacy ciphers.
Sam Chen: From a mitigation perspective: revert the RBAC delta for cert-provisioner on eu canary, or temporarily pin the proxy to use cached certs (prefix cache) until KMS access stabilizes.
Maria Gonzalez: Rolling back the RBAC change on canary now. Also, we need better instrumentation: we have lots of TLS logs but no slicing by `kms_unwrap_duration` in our dashboards.
Jess Liu: Agree. Proposed short-term: add a Tag/field `kms_unwrap_ms` to TLS logs, sample 100% for the canary region for 15m, then switch to 1% global sampling. Also increase audit log retention for the cert-provisioner service for 72h.
secops-bot: Incident created: INC-20241108-0345 — "proxy eu TLS downgrade during cert-provisioner RBAC change" (assigned: Ivan Petrov).
Ivan Petrov: I'll own the incident. Action items: 1) Verify RBAC rollback and confirm no 403s 2) Run KMS latency sweep (see command) 3) Add temporary 100% verbose TLS logs in eu canary.
Sam Chen: KMS latency sweep command (quick): ```bash
# list recent unwrap latency for key alias
gcloud kms operations list --filter="resource:projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/prod/cryptoKeys/cert-wrap" --limit=50
# or via AWS: aws kms list-key-usage --key-id alias/cert-wrap
```
Maria Gonzalez: After rollback I still see a few stragglers but much reduced. I'm capturing full logs and will upload to the incident ticket.
Jess Liu: For longer-term: we should update our TLS telemetry and audit-sampling policy: - always capture full TLS negotiation details for 10% of sessions per region (higher in canaries) - surface `kms_unwrap_ms` as a metric to alert on >500ms - audit the cert provisioning role mapping test in CI
Sam Chen: Also model-ingest service needs a client-side TLS config check: ensure it doesn't artificially downgrade when facing transient server timeouts. Add an integration test that simulates KMS latency and validates TLS negotiation remains TLS1.3 if cert still valid.
Ivan Petrov: I'll add a small vulnerability triage note: if KMS permissions are mis-scoped and allow a different service to rewrap keys, that's a privilege escalation path. Add to next weekly vuln review.
Maria Gonzalez: Thanks team. I'll post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems after the incident wrap. For now rollback + 100% sampling in eu-canary + monitor `kms_unwrap_ms` alerts at 500ms.
Jess Liu: Great. One more ask: add a trimmed query for Datadog/Signal for quick checks: ```
# Datadog log query
logs("service:proxy AND region:eu AND tls_handshake:client_negotiated:TLS1.2") | measure(avg, "attributes.kms_unwrap_ms")
```
Sam Chen: Nice. Will add runbook steps to the incident ticket. :thumbsup:
Maria Gonzalez: Closing the loop — RBAC rollback removed 403s, unwrap latency is within baseline, no further downgrades in last 10m. I'll keep the 100% sample on for 20m then reduce.
Ivan Petrov: Closing out: follow-up items in INC-20241108-0345: RBAC test in CI, telemetry keys, vuln-review.
secops-bot: Incident INC-20241108-0345 updated: status=investigating -> monitoring.
